title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1969-09-26

ai_review.summary: A sub‑par audience recording of a Fall 1969 Fillmore East show, but the explosive Dark Star (with St. Stephen → The Eleven) makes it worthwhile for completists.
ai_review.review: The tape is widely described as low‑fidelity and hard to listen to – VBR/OGG streams are called “not really listenable” and “sub‑par”.  Despite the poor sound, reviewers repeatedly praise Jerry Garcia’s lightning‑fast, on‑fire guitar work during a remarkable Dark Star that rolls into St. Stephen and The Eleven, calling it a highlight of the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently negative comments on recording quality lower the overall score, but strong positive remarks about the Dark Star performance raise it to a modestly above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers note sub‑par VBR/OGG audio, muffled or “gargly” sound, and general unlistenable quality, though a few mention very little audience noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers focus on the “Holy Trinity” sequence (Dark Star → St. Stephen → The Eleven), describing it as a key highlight despite overall recording issues.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as lightning‑fast, on fire, and delivering one of the best Dark Stars; some reviewers even call it the “best star ever”.
